snippet.title: Painkiller - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The gates of Purgatory have blown wide open, and Azazel's dark armies fester at its very heart. It's up to you to blast your way through his demonic hordes and face his grotesque children, the Nephilim. 

🤝 Champions Unite
Choose from four distinct Champions with unique perks and embark on a violent quest for redemption. Watch each other’s backs, and leave nothing standing.

🏰 Halls of the Damned
Fight your way across multiple levels spread across three brutal biomes. Many terrors await you, from countless swarming demons to towering Nephilim, each hellbent on your destruction. 

⚖ Judgement's Tools
Arm yourselves and choose from an arsenal of seven devastating weapons. Whether you're looking to spray, slice, pierce, or obliterate, our armory has you covered. 

🃏 Fury and Fortune
Upgrade your armaments with frightening elemental fury and equip Tarot cards to converge, power up, and maximize your team's abilities.

🎲 Trials of the Damned
Enter a new realm of Purgatory in Rogue Angel mode, and charge through randomized arenas that challenge your ability to adapt at every turn. Collect tarot cards, weapons, and items along the way and shape your shared destiny.

🍂 Season of Torment
Champions who acquire the season pass will receive three releases of content. Night Watch, Metal as Hell, and Demon Awakening, totalling 12 character outfits and 18 weapon skins. Purgatory never looked so good.  

The hour is upon us. Rally your friends, upgrade your arsenal, equip your tarot cards and give 'em hell! 

==================== 

SONG: "Sons of Purgatory" - original music and lyrics written and recorded by Painkiller OST Composers Steve Molitz (Saber Interactive), Vikram Shankar (Within Temptation) and Tom S. Englund (Evergrey). 

Within Temptation: www.youtube.com/@wtofficial
Evergrey: www.youtube.com/@evergreyofficial
